text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace was brimming with 
frustration. Even if she wins, the 
public's perception doesn't change. 
Weighed down by these thoughts, she 
corners herself.

Just as the Trainer was at their wit's 
end, an email arrives from an 
organization. It provides a clue to 
breaking through the stalemate.

The Trainer came up with a way to clear 
away Katsuragi Ace's impatience. And 
amidst all that, the summer training camp 
was about to begin.
